reviews.comment: Easy A. Generous grader, just follow his rubrics and use his feedback. Bit of a weird guy.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
American Lit Civil War to Present was interesting.
There are a few major writing assignments that account for most of your grade. He grades generously on these so long as you avoid his writing pet peeves.
Attendance is mandatory and lectures can feel long.
Overall a very easy class and I got better at writing.

Dr. Manes seems very intimidating at first, but I promise you he is not. If you go to his office hours and actually communicate with him, you find that he is a very caring professor. He gives feedback that if you use it in your future papers, it is very easy to get a good grade. He gives extra credit.

Took him for ENG 228. Class is super easy; outside of two unit briefs, I might've spent an hour a week outside of class on the course. Attendance is mandatory, and the lectures are a pain to attend; I genuinely don't think I learned much from them. Easy and chill class, do not take it if you are actually interested in learning American Literature.
Dude is so weird and awkward but class was so easy it was a joke compared to other hullabaloo classes I heard about.

Took for transnat. 306 & Am. lit. 228 and got A+ in both, easy to get good grade if you follow the rubric & common errors. I don't care if he forgot my name or some of the things other people are saying, an easy A is an easy A. He's nice & will help you and help missed work. 3 free absences, 5% off every non-excused after 3. Boring lectures though.

There aren't many assignments for this class other than a one-page paper most weeks, which took ~40 mins to write & all followed the same basic formula. If you incorporate his feedback, it's easy to ace the essays. He's accessible outside of class & eager to give advice. Most classes were skippable. There was an annoying group project at the end.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This guy forgot my name 4 or 5 separate times, and it is a pretty uncommon name. One time, HE booked an appointment with me and then forgot who I was (and seemed bothered by my presence itself when I did show up). He also generally treated our HU class like an 8th grade class. He's not qualified to be as condescending and rude as he is.

Told me his "friend's" experience in the Holocaust "did not count" because she didn't get numbers tattooed on her arm, which is perhaps the most offensive thing I could ever think of saying. Also talks exceeding slow and never gets to the point.

This was my freshman Hullabaloo class, so I hope this brings hope to other freshman who are forced into this section (as I was).  Overly strict on class that is worth ZERO credit hours. It almost felt like high school with how nitpicky he was with phones. He was slightly passive aggressive at times, but he was kind of nice when talking to him 1-1.

Dr. Manes is not the nicest professor and a no-nonsense prof, but as long as you show up to class, are prepared to answer questions, and pay close attention to his guidelines and feedback, you'll do good. He will only deduct points if you don't follow the instructions or repeat a mistake. Go to his office hours! He is very helpful and grades nicer
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: CHOOSE ANOTHER PROF! If you take him, you will be paying tuition to teach yourself. Relied soley on recordings and coursework from his peers. Slow grader-85% of the MANY assignments were not graded until the last 4 days of the semester. Easy grader-most probably because he had to rush before grades were due. Not responsive to students.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This was an online class and it was completely on your time. There were assignments due every day of the week M-F.  There is a major group project towards the end of the class and it's easy to do as long as you put in the effort. He graded assignments late like 4 weeks late but he grades easily and gives good feedback which is awesome.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Despite other negative reviews, Mr. Manes is generally a good professor from my experience. It is easy to access him outside of class if you talk to him, and you can schedule meetings with him to discuss your rough drafts to improve your final draft grade. Pace is easy to keep up with, and deadlines are flexible.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Manes was a good professor for an entry English class. He was fair in his grading, and he gave good feedback. I would take this specific class again if needed. Yes, the essays are lengthy, but he gives plenty of time and advice to help you through the writing assignments. I recommend asking questions and attending class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! Lectures with Dr. Manes is the biggest waste of time and hefty college tuition. Nothing in his lectures pertain or is useful to the multiple essays he assigns, and his grading is the worst I've ever seen. Students are lucky to get a high 70 just on drafts themselves, and he does not respond to your emails. Bad for entry Eng.
